```{r}
#| warning: False

required_packages <-function(...) { 
  libs<-unlist(list(...)) 
  req<-suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(unlist(lapply(libs,require,character.only=TRUE)))) 
  need<-libs[req==FALSE] 
  if(length(need)>0){ 
    install.packages(need, repos = "http://cran.us.r-project.org") 
    lapply(need, library, character.only=TRUE) 
  }
  else{message("No packages required installation.")} 
} #The code above was not written by myself but taken from my data science class. Credit to Scott Appleby.
```

```{r}
  full_join(read_xlsx(path = "Abiotics/CSULB/CSULB Master.xlsx","SM") |>
              pivot_longer(cols = -DateTime, 
               names_to = "Site_Location", 
               values_to = "SM") |>
              separate(Site_Location, into = c("Site", "Location"), sep = "_") |>
              mutate(Campus = "CSULB"),
            by = c("DateTime", "Site", "SM", "Location", "Campus")) |> 
  mutate(Month = month(DateTime, label = T, abbr = T),
         Time = hms(format(DateTime, "%H:%M:%S"))) |> 
  filter(!Month %in% c("Feb", "Oct", "Nov"))
```

### Filtering Known Issues

```{r}
#| message: False
VPD_All <- VPD_All_Inported |> 
  #Removed only because it was removed from the other data set (an is likely sunned off)
  filter(!(Campus == "CSULB" & Site == "Off" & DateTime >= mdy_hms("03-05-2025 12:30:00") & DateTime <= mdy_hms("03-05-2025 18:00:00")),
         !(Campus == "CSULB" & Site == "Off" & DateTime >= mdy_hms("03-06-2025 13:00:00") & DateTime <= mdy_hms("03-06-2025 18:00:00")),) |> 
  filter(!Month %in% c("Feb","Oct","Nov"),
         !Campus == "CSUSM",
         #More known sunning of shade logger only
         !(Campus == "Whittier" & Site == "On" &
           DateTime >= ymd_hms("2025-06-01 00:00:00") &
           DateTime <= ymd_hms("2025-08-07 19:00:00")),
         !(Campus == "Whittier" & Site == "On" &
           DateTime >= ymd_hms("2025-09-11 12:30:00")),
         #!(Campus == "Pepperdine" & Site == "On" & DateTime > as.POSIXct("2025-08-17 00:00:00"))
         ) |> 
  left_join(
    dplyr::select(Temp_All, !c("Sun", "Shade", "Time", "Time_sec", "Season")), 
            by = c("Campus", "DateTime", "Site", "Month", "MonthDayYear")) |> 
  dplyr::select(!c("Temp", "VPD")) |> 
  mutate(es = (.611 * (exp((17.502 * Ambient )/(Ambient + 240.97)))),
         ea = es * (RH/100),
         VPD = es - ea)
```

## SM Models

### glmmTMB set up for SM

```{r}
Zeros_Sun <- glmmTMB(
  mean ~ Site * Month + poly(Time,2) + (1|Campus) + 
    (1|Site:Campus) +  (1|Month:Site:Campus),
   ziformula = ~ Site + Month,
  family = tweedie(link = "log"),
  data = LM_SM_Sun_Zeros_df)

Zeros_Shade <- glmmTMB(
  mean ~ Site * Month + poly(Time,2) + (1|Campus) + 
    (1|Site:Campus) +  (1|Month:Site:Campus),
   ziformula = ~ 1,
  family = tweedie(link = "log"),
  data = LM_SM_Shade_Zeros_df)
```

### Results for SM

```{r}
Anova(Zeros_Sun, component = "cond") #Conditional model
pairs(emmeans(Zeros_Sun, specs = ~ Site|Month, 
              type = "response", component = "cond"), 
      # reverse = TRUE, 
      adjust = "tukey")
summary(pairs(emmeans(Zeros_Sun, ~ Site | Month), 
              #reverse = TRUE, 
              adjust = "tukey"),
        type = "response", component = "cond",
        infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))
```

### LMER set up for VPD

```{r}
lm_VPD <- lmer(log(mean) ~ 
                    Site + Month +
                    poly(Time, 4) + 
                    (1|Campus) + 
                    (1|Site:Campus) +
                    (1|Month:Site:Campus), 
                  REML = FALSE,
                  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"),
                  data = LM_VPD_HourlyAvgsLong)

lm_VPD_cv <- lmer(log(cv) ~ 
                    Site + Month +
                    poly(Time, 4) + 
                    (1|Campus) + 
                    (1|Site:Campus)+
                    (1|Month:Site:Campus), 
                  REML = FALSE,
                  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"),
                  data = LM_VPD_HourlyAvgsLong)
```

### Results for VPD

```{r}
anova(lm_VPD)
#emmeans(lm_VPD, ~ Month)
summary(emmeans(lm_VPD, ~ Month), type = "response")

anova(lm_VPD_cv)
pairs(emmeans(lm_VPD_cv, ~ Site, type = "response"), reverse = TRUE)
summary(emmeans(lm_VPD_cv, ~ Site), type = "response")

emmeans(lm_VPD_cv, ~ Month, type = "response")
summary(emmeans(lm_VPD_cv, ~ Month), 
        type = "response")
```

## Visualizations

### SM

```{r}
site_cols <- c("On"  = "#56B4E9",  
               "Off" = "#E69F00")
site_labs <- c("On"  = "Urban",
               "Off" = "Non-urban")
time_grid <- seq(6.5, 20, by = 0.5)


make_conditional_predictions <- function(model, location, times) {
  emmeans(
    model,
    specs = ~ Site | Month + Time,
    at = list(Time = times),
    component = "cond",
    type = "response") |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    mutate(
      Location = location,
      Time_hr = Time,
      Site = factor(Site, levels = c("On", "Off")))}

# Conditional-model predictions
pred_sun <- make_conditional_predictions(
  Zeros_Sun, "Sun", time_grid)

pred_shade <- make_conditional_predictions(
  Zeros_Shade, "Shade", time_grid)

pred_sm <- bind_rows(pred_sun, pred_shade) |>
  mutate(
    Location = factor(Location, levels = c("Shade", "Sun")))

# Observed campus values (raw data)
obs_sm <- bind_rows(
  LM_SM_Sun_Zeros_df |> mutate(Location = "Sun"),
  LM_SM_Shade_Zeros_df |> mutate(Location = "Shade")) |>
  mutate(
    Time_hr = Time,
    Location = factor(Location, levels = c("Shade", "Sun")),
    Site = factor(Site, levels = c("On", "Off")),
    grey_color = if_else(Site == "On", "grey50", "grey75")) |>
  filter(Time_hr >= 6.5, Time_hr <= 20)

ggplot() + 
  geom_line(data = obs_sm,
    aes(x = Time_hr, y = mean, group = interaction(Campus, Site), 
        linetype = Site, color = grey_color),
    # color = "grey55", 
        alpha = 0.45, linewidth = 0.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  # geom_ribbon( # 95% CIs
  #   data = pred_sm,
  #   aes(x = Time_hr, ymin = asymp.LCL, ymax = asymp.UCL, fill = Site, group = Site),
  #   alpha = 0.22, color = NA) +
  geom_line(  #Conditional-model predicted means
    data = pred_sm,
    aes(x = Time_hr, y = response, color = Site, group = Site), linewidth = 1.15) +
  facet_grid(Location ~ Month) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = site_cols, labels = site_labs, name = "Site") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = site_cols, labels = site_labs, name = "Site") +
  scale_x_continuous( 
    name = "Time of Day", breaks = c(8, 13, 18), labels = paste0(c(8, 13, 18), ":00")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.4)) +
  # scale_y_sqrt(
  #   breaks = c(0, 0.01, 0.04, 0.09, 0.16, 0.25, 0.36))+
  labs(
    y = expression("Conditional Soil Moisture (" * m^3 / m^3 * ")")) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -45, hjust = 0), 
    text = element_text(family = "Times")
  )
```

```{r}
#| warning: False

VPD_Graph <- VPD_HourlyAvgsLong |>

    Month_num = match(as.character(Month), month.abb),

    grey_color = if_else(Site == "On", "grey60", "grey75"),
    Site = factor(Site, levels = c("On", "Off")))

pred_VPD <- emmeans(lm_VPD_cv, ~ Site | Month + Time,

ggplot() +

  # reference line (campus-averaged)
  geom_ribbon(data = pred_VPD,
              aes(x = Time, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL,

              ), alpha = .25)+
  scale_fill_identity(name = "Site",
                      breaks = okabe_ito[c(2, 1)])+
```

```{r}
break_low  <- 150
break_high <- 200
display_gap <- 30

break_y <- function(x) {
  if_else(
    x <= break_low, 
    x,
    x - (break_high - break_low) + display_gap)
  }

VPD_Graph_break <- VPD_Graph |>
  mutate(cv_break = break_y(cv))

pred_VPD_break <- pred_VPD |>
  mutate(
    response_break = break_y(response),
    lower_break = break_y(lower.CL),
    upper_break = break_y(upper.CL))

ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    data = VPD_Graph_break,
    aes(
      x = Time_hr, y = cv_break,
      group = interaction(Campus, Site),
      color = grey_color, linetype = Site),
    alpha = 0.45, linewidth = 0.8, show.legend = F) +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = pred_VPD_break,
    aes(
      x = Time,
      ymin = lower_break, ymax = upper_break,
      fill = Site_color, group = Site),
    alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_line(
    data = pred_VPD_break,
    aes(
      x = Time, y = response_break,
      color = Site_color,
      group = interaction(Month, Site)),
    linewidth = 1.2) +
  facet_wrap(~Month, ncol = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "CV for VPD",
    breaks = c(0, 70, 150, 200, 270),
    labels = c(0, 70, 150, 280, 350))+
  # geom_hline(yintercept = 165, linewidth = 2.5, color = "white")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 165, linewidth = .2, color = "grey", linetype = "dashed")+
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "Time of Day",
    breaks = c(8, 13, 18),
    labels = paste0(c(8, 13, 18), ":00")) +
  scale_fill_identity(
    name = "Site",
    breaks = okabe_ito[c(2, 1)]) +
  scale_color_identity(
    name = "Site",
    breaks = okabe_ito[c(2, 1)],
    labels = c("Urban", "Non-urban"),
    guide = "legend") +
  # annotate(geom = "rect", xmin = -1, xmax = 1, ymin = 150, ymax = 165)+
  labs(color = "Site") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18), 
    text = element_text(family = "Times"))
```

## Data Checks

```{r}
qqnorm(resid(lm_VPD))
plot(lm_VPD)

qqnorm(resid(lm_VPD_cv))
plot(lm_VPD_cv)


boxplot(residuals(lm_VPD) ~ LM_VPD_HourlyAvgsLong$Month)
boxplot(residuals(lm_VPD) ~ LM_VPD_HourlyAvgsLong$Site)

simulationOutput <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = lm_VPD, n = 500)
plot(simulationOutput)#Plotting results
testDispersion(simulationOutput)#Testing for overdispersion.


infl <- hlm_influence(lm_VPD_cv)
infl[order(-infl$cooksd),][1:10,]
ggplot(infl, aes(x = leverage.overall, 
                 y = cooksd)) +
  geom_point() 
```

```{r}
library("performance")

Zeros_Sun$sdr$pdHess
```

```{r}
testZeroInflation(res_Sun)
```
